title: Preset Manifest
description: Metadata for a single glossary preset in the papia-presets catalog.

id.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the preset's directory name.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the marketplace UI.

nameKriolu.description: Optional Kriolu translation of the name, used when the marketplace is shown in Kriolu.

description.description: One-paragraph summary of what this preset covers and who it's for.

domain.description: Top-level domain category. Use 'other' for niche domains and explain in the description.

version.description: Semver version. Bump on every update.

license.description: All presets in this catalog use the MIT License.

entryCount.description: Number of entries in glossary.json. Must match exactly — CI verifies.

dialects.description: Dialects represented in the preset. Use 'mixed' only if entries draw from multiple dialects without a dominant one.

sourceLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source language for entries.

targetLanguage.description: ISO 639-3 code of the target language. Currently only 'kea' (Cabo Verdean Kriolu).

authors.description: Authors credited for the preset content. Order signals lead authorship.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles authorized to merge updates without separate review.

sources.description: Where the terminology comes from — published references, expert consultation, community review. Required.

alupecValidated.description: Set by CI, not the author. True when every target term passes the ALUPEC linter without errors.

createdAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the preset was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest update. Bump on every version change.

minSkrebeVersion.description: Minimum Skrebe app version required to install this preset. Use when relying on a feature added in a specific release.
